title: Tiny, cute birthday cake with candles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='cakeGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3d9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6fb5'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='frostGlow' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fffef0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9f5'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- cake plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='38' ry='7' fill='#7fe0ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='34' ry='5.5' fill='#a9ecff'/>
  <!-- cake body -->
  <rect x='20' y='50' width='60' height='32' rx='6' fill='url(#cakeGlow)'/>
  <!-- frosting drip top -->
  <path d='M20 56 Q20 48 28 48 L72 48 Q80 48 80 56 L80 58 Q76 58 76 62 Q76 58 72 58 Q68 58 68 63 Q68 58 63 58 Q58 58 58 62 Q58 58 53 58 Q48 58 48 62 Q48 58 43 58 Q38 58 38 62 Q38 58 33 58 Q28 58 28 62 Q28 58 24 58 Q20 58 20 56 Z' fill='url(#frostGlow)'/>

  <rect x='30' y='66' width='5' height='2.2' rx='1.1' fill='#ffd23f' transform='rotate(25 32 67)'/>

  <rect x='58' y='70' width='5' height='2.2' rx='1.1' fill='#ffd23f' transform='rotate(40 60 71)'/>

  <rect x='62' y='66' width='5' height='2.2' rx='1.1' fill='#8fd8ff' transform='rotate(10 64 67)'/>
  <rect x='28' y='74' width='5' height='2.2' rx='1.1' fill='#8fd8ff' transform='rotate(55 30 75)'/>
  <!-- candles -->
  <!-- candle 1 -->
  <rect x='33' y='30' width='5' height='18' rx='2' fill='#9c6bff'/>
  <rect x='33' y='33' width='5' height='2' fill='#d6bcff'/>
  <rect x='33' y='39' width='5' height='2' fill='#d6bcff'/>

  <ellipse cx='35.5' cy='25' rx='3.2' ry='5' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <ellipse cx='35.5' cy='26' rx='1.6' ry='2.8' fill='#fff3a0'/>

  <rect x='47.5' y='26' width='5' height='22' rx='2' fill='#2fe0c8'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='30' width='5' height='2' fill='#a8fff1'/>
  <rect x='47.5' y='37' width='5' height='2' fill='#a8fff1'/>
  <!-- flame 2 -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='21' rx='3.2' ry='5' fill='#ffb03a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='22' rx='1.6' ry='2.8' fill='#fff3a0'/>
  <!-- candle 3 -->
  <rect x='62' y='31' width='5' height='17' rx='2' fill='#ff5f9e'/>
  <rect x='62' y='34' width='5' height='2' fill='#ffc0d8'/>
